title: Civil Services Qualification For Appointment as High Court Judge Amendment Act 1988

sections.shortTitle: Civil Services Qualification For Appointment as High Court Judge Amendment Act 1988
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1988
CIVIL SERVICES (QUALIFICATION, FOR
APPOINTMENT
AS HIGH COURT JUDGE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
ACT I OF 1988
An Act further to amend the Civil
Services (Qualification
for Appointment as High Court Judge)
Act, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 17th February, 1988]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 9th February, 1988, and is hereby published for
general information:---
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Civil
Services (Qualification for Appointment as High Court Judge) (Amendment) Act,
1988.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Act XXI of 1965

ACT I OF 1988
CIVIL SERVICES (QUALIFICATION, FOR
APPOINTMENT
AS HIGH COURT JUDGE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
ACT I OF 1988
An Act further to amend the Civil
Services (Qualification
for Appointment as High Court Judge)
Act, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 17th February, 1988]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 9th February, 1988, and is hereby published for
general information:---
2. Amendment of section 2, Act XXI of 1965.--In the Civil Services
(Qualification for Appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965 (XXI of 1965), in
section 2,--
(a) in the marginal heading, for
the letters "CSP" the words and letters "certain Groups of
APUG" shall be substituted; and
(b) for the words "Civil
Service of Pakistan" the words and commas "Secretariat Group and
District Management Group of the All-Pakistan Unified Grades, and the
successors of the said Groups from time to time," shall be substituted.
